page.layout: One title page, centred, all text in one block: title, author, imprint and privilege lines. Handwritten shelfmarks and a library stamp at left are not printed text and are omitted.
page.notes: Handwritten shelfmarks ("Bibliot. Loc. Coll. Nom. doc. Segn.") and the oval library stamp (Biblioteca Nazionale, Roma, Vittorio Emanuele) are not printed text and are left out. A decorative woodcut ornament sits in the centre of the page; it is not transcribed. The "Digitized by Google" watermark at lower right is left out. The printer's text is clear throughout; no doubtful readings. The printed "QVA", "PERSPICVE", "TVRRETTINO" and "LVGD" have been normalised to U as per the u/v rule.
